title: vulpia myuros var. broteri
intro: Vulpia myuros var. broteri, commonly known as Six-hill bluegrass, is a subspecies of the annual grass Vulpia myuros. It is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Poaceae, and is native to the Iberian Peninsula. The health benefits of Vulpia myuros var. broteri include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health, while its therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
